source: Episode 1 approved takes (Sunny and Gogo studio)

jobs.name: picture
args: Vertical 9:16 frame from a soft rounded 3D animated children's cartoon in the sunny meadow (big oak tree, golden morning light, daisies). Medium shot of the very large apricot dog Sunny on four paws (shaggy curly coat, long floppy ears, pink bandana with red strawberries) walking happily through the meadow toward the big oak, singing softly, seen from the side. He is the only character in the picture: no girl, no other animals. No text. Reviewer note: Lena hair and dress are different

jobs.name: composed_scene
jobs.what: composed picture, step 1: the scene without Mochi (shot 06a: 3 reference pictures)
args: Vertical 9:16 frame from a soft rounded 3D animated children's cartoon in the sunny meadow (big oak tree, golden morning light, daisies). Medium-wide shot of a gentle walk toward the big oak tree. In the RIGHT foreground, large and close to the camera, the very large apricot dog Sunny on four paws (shaggy curly coat, long floppy ears, pink bandana with red strawberries), much bigger than the girl faces the camera and sings with his mouth open. Behind on the LEFT, the toddler girl Gogo (honey-brown braids with pink ties, big blue eyes, pink long-sleeve dress with red strawberries, cream leggings, pink rain boots) walks beside the lavender toy stroller (lavender seat and folded-back hood, thin champagne-silver frame, black wheels with pink hubs, one wheel per leg) with her soft plush doll Lena (lavender sleeper, cream bonnet, stitched eyes and a stitched smile; a still toy) sitting inside; a small empty patch of grass just behind its back wheels. No squirrel, no other animals. No text.

jobs.name: composed_repaint
jobs.what: composed picture, step 2: zoomed repaint of Mochi with her LoRA (768x768)
args: mochisquirrel. The small cartoon squirrel (caramel-brown fur, cream face and belly, pink inner ears, big fluffy caramel tail, no clothes) stands on her hind legs behind the stroller wheel with both front paws on the stroller's low frame bar, smiling, with a soft shadow on the grass. Same size and place as now, same soft 3D cartoon style and golden light. Keep the girl's boots, the wheel and the grass unchanged.

jobs.name: video
jobs.what: 5-second video from a start picture (shot 06e, 121 frames)
args: Vertical 9:16 shot from a soft rounded 3D animated children's cartoon, golden morning light. Static camera unless stated. No music, no text. The plush doll Lena is a toy: her stitched mouth never opens and she never moves on her own. Medium shot: Gogo walks and sings sweetly, her mouth moving with the song, looking down kindly.

jobs.name: lipsync_video
jobs.what: 5.4-second lip-sync video driven by Sunny's line (shot 09, a2v)
args: Vertical 9:16 shot from a soft rounded 3D animated children's cartoon, golden morning light. Static camera unless stated. No music, no text. The plush doll Lena is a toy: her stitched mouth never opens and she never moves on her own. Wide shot: Sunny smiles warmly and says: "Waiting is hard. We can take turns.", his mouth moving with his words while Gogo and Mochi smile with their mouths closed. Then everyone sways gently and happily together. The camera holds still for a soft loop. Reviewer note: there is an extra tree Same location and background as the previous shot: same oak tree, meadow and golden light. Problem areas: at 3.8 s, in the middle left of the frame.
